title: Guards, and why the other acts are absent

html:
Guards, and why the other acts are absent

# 200 OK
Content-Type: application/hal+json
Content-Profile: <https://w3id.org/heart-rise/
                  hal-schema-forms>
ETag: "seq-0.hsf.L0.6042001a61e14760"
Cache-Control: no-cache
Vary: Accept, Prefer, Accept-Profile
Link: <…/pulls/2325>; rel="alternate";
        type="application/prs.hal-forms+json",
      <…/pulls/2325>; rel="alternate"; type="text/html"
# the act carries what it read
PUT /repos/…/pulls/2325/actions/merge
If-Match: "seq-0.hsf.L0.6042001a61e14760"
{method: squash}
# changed since? 412, not a lost update
_links:
  hr:unavailable:
    href: /unavailable/bf257b5ee24d7901
    integrity: sha256-vyV7XuJNeQF8…
# GET /unavailable/bf257b5ee24d7901  (as served)
unavailable:
  - rel: /profiles/scm#reopen
    title: Reopen
    reason: The pull request is already open.
# the reason is the connector's own words:
# github-scm/pull.reader.yaml
#   open:
#     absent:
#       reopen: The pull request is
#               already open.

pull.reader.yaml
say: The whole answer's headers: the profile, the ETag, no-cache, and the alternates the gateway also serves (HAL-FORMS, text/html, plain JSON). An act sends the ETag back as If-Match: if the pull request changed since it was read, the answer is 412, not a lost update. And the absent acts have reasons: reopen isn't offered because the pull request is already open, in the connector's own words.
